title: Changing your mind without rewriting the past
method: A conceptual sequence for the reflection exercise in this essay. The steps describe a possible practice, not a measured causal effect or a universal rule.
alt: Concept diagram: Preserve the old view — Record the assumption and original context.; Name new evidence — Explain what changed and how much.; Revise the action — Separate a pause from a replacement decision.; Update the record — Reach people using the earlier advice..
